title.zh-CN: Wingspan：栖息地怎样把鸟牌组织成一条引擎？
title.en: Wingspan: How Does a Habitat Organize Birds into an Engine?

summary.zh-CN: 用两张真实森林鸟的一次取食，解释栖息地怎样组织重复收益，以及生态主题的表达边界。
summary.en: Use one food action with two real forest birds to examine how habitats organize repeated benefits and where ecological interpretation needs limits.
